{{Quote|Here's what you've been sent to see, Commander."<br />"The new model warbot the Empire threw at your ground troops on Xeron...!|A Rebel trooper and Luke Skywalker|<ref name="marvel47" />}}
'''Imperial warbots''' were huge [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] released to supplement [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] ground forces following the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]. Although not considered as menacing as [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-ATs]], they were nonetheless deadly&mdash;warbots played a crucial role in the [[Battle of Xeron]], and were capable of fighting many foes at once using its [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannons]]. One damaged unit fell into the hands of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], and was later unleashed against Imperial-aligned [[Droid/Legends|droids]] on [[Kligson's Moon/Legends|Kligson's Moon]].

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|They're not in the same class as those AT-ATs you and General Rieekan's people faced on Hoth... but it's no picnic fighting 'em!|A Rebel trooper|<ref name="marvel47" />}}
A [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Imperial warbot resembled a mobile turret, with treaded wheels, two clawed arms, and a rotating head equipped with [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannons]]. Several times taller than the average [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], the warbots packed a significant punch, although [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] troops did not believe them as fearsome as the [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transports]] that pounded the Rebels on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. Imperial warbots were far from invulnerable, and the skilled [[Technician/Legends|technician]] [[Kligson/Legends|Kligson]] scorned what he saw as their shoddy craftsmanship, although they could be repaired rather simply using parts from similar machines.<ref name="marvel47" />

==History==
{{Quote|A product of the Empire...! Typical cheapjack craftsmanship! The diagram indicates proper reconstruction&mdash;but this kind of product isn't worth the effort. Most Imperial handiwork isn't.|Kligson|<ref name="marvel47" />}}
[[File:Warbott.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A warbot crushes Z-X3's forces]]
A creation of the Imperial war effort in the months after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], Imperial warbots were in use against Rebel forces as early as [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], playing an important role in the [[Battle of Xeron]]. The effect they had against Rebel ground troops on [[Xeron]] brought them to the attention of the Rebel brass, which made capturing an intact specimen a priority. A damaged warbot fell into the hands of Rebel [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] not long after, prompting Skywalker to seek out the famed reclusive technician Kligson, whom he hoped could examine the droid and provide a full schematic. Kligson, a [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] who oversaw a community of [[Droid/Legends|droids]] on the "Droid World" [[Kligson's Moon/Legends|Kligson's Moon]], accepted the offer on the condition that he be allowed to repair and keep the machine.<ref name="marvel47" />

However, Kligson wasn't the only one with designs on the warbot. Although the cyborg had kept his moon officially out of the Galactic Civil War, his chief [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]], [[Z-X3|Zee-Exthree]], secretly led a [[Z-X3's faction|faction]] of Imperial-aligned droids that plotted to overthrow Kligson and deliver the "Droid World" to the Empire. Zee-Exthree also had come into possession of a damaged warbot, and hoped to use Skywalker's droid to repair their model and unleash it in their coup. However, they were outwitted and defeated by Kligson in the ensuing [[Kligson's Moon civil war|civil war]], after the cyborg rebuilt Skywalker's droid and utterly destroyed Zee-Exthree's faction.<ref name="marvel47" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial warbot first appeared in [[Star Wars (1977) 47|''Star Wars'' (1977) 47]], written by [[Archie Goodwin]] and released in [[1981]]. In the comic, the warbot was illustrated by [[Carmine Infantino]].<ref name="marvel47" />
